Shiva Ayyadurai

Independent candidate for Senator in Congress, Massachusetts · Challenger

Scientist and entrepreneur

Shiva Ayyadurai is a scientist and entrepreneur from Belmont who holds four degrees from MIT. He is running for U.S. Senate in Massachusetts as an independent. He ran for the Senate as an independent in 2018 and in the Republican primary in 2020, and ran for president as an independent in 2024.

Where Ayyadurai stands

Election administration
Supports using paper ballots in elections.
Abortion
Describes himself as "pro-life."
Health care
Says he would protect what he calls "medical freedom."

Background

  • Independent candidate for U.S. Senate, Massachusetts, 2018
  • Candidate in the Republican primary for U.S. Senate, Massachusetts, 2020
  • Independent candidate for President, 2024
  • Scientist, inventor and entrepreneur; founder of several businesses in biological systems and computer science; author; former MIT lecturer
  • B.S. (1986), master's (1990) and Ph.D. (2007), Massachusetts Institute of Technology
  • Born in Bombay (Mumbai), India; lives in Belmont, Mass.
